concerns.text: The stated blocking dependencies (T045, T046, T051, T053, T050, T055, T043, T044 MUST be completed before T013...) are overly broad. While logically correct, this creates a massive sequential bottleneck.  Tasks within Phase 2 that *don't* directly feed into the initial US-1 tasks (T013 onwards) should be marked [P] to allow parallel execution.
T045 states 'This task MUST be executed first in Phase 2'. This is an absolute dependency and needs explicit enforcement (e.g., a pre-commit hook or CI check) to prevent accidental parallelization.
T046 explicitly depends on T045, but isn't marked as such in the task list format (no dependency tag). This makes it harder to track dependencies at a glance.

The 'Staged Implementation Authorization' block within Phase 3 is repetitive and verbose. The core message – that the initial implementation uses simulation data due to real data unavailability – could be conveyed more concisely.

T013 includes a lengthy pre-requisite check ('MUST verify state/mdes_report.yaml exists...'). While important, this should ideally be handled by the task execution script itself (fail fast if missing) rather than being explicitly stated in the task description.
The sub-tasks within T015 are overly detailed for a high-level task list. These details belong in implementation notes or code comments, not the task description itself.
